name: Dorfstub'n
kurzbeschreibung:
**Cozy village taverns in Neukirchen am Großvenediger**

Discover the warm, rustic charm of **Tirol**’s hidden gems in **Neukirchen am Großvenediger**, where traditional **Dorfstub’n** (village taverns) invite you to unwind after a day of hiking or skiing. Savor hearty **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, and **Speckknödel**, paired with crisp **Tiroler Bier** or smooth **Graubündner Wein**. The crackling fireplaces, hand-carved wooden furniture, and cheerful locals create an atmosphere where time slows down—just as nature intended in the shadow of the **Großvenediger**. Whether you’re craving a hearty **Kaspressknödel** or a sweet **Apfelstrudel**, these taverns serve up more than just food—they offer a taste of **Tirol**’s soul. Don’t miss the chance to try **Tiroler Gröstl** or **Leberkäse** with a side of **Tiroler Bergkäse** and fresh **Brot** from the local bakeries. A visit to **Neukirchen am Großvenediger** is incomplete without a stop at one of its beloved **Dorfstub’n**, where every bite tells a story of the mountains.
